technical_replication_omission: OSD-168 lacks the RR3 41-day F6, G6, and G7 biological material; only 39- and 40-day RR3 animals were technically remeasured.
aligned_fraction_pattern: strictly increasing numerically, but effectively plateaus from day 40 to 41
magnitude_pattern: non-monotonic: lower at day 40 and highest at day 41
conventional_pattern: non-monotonic: lower at day 40 and highest at day 41
caveat: Only three time points; day 41 has 1 FLT and 2 GC samples. No inferential time-trend claim is supported.
